memory_candidates: InputCtx.fillLhs (Nested/Context.lean, Arisaka-Das-Strassburger nested-sequent formalization) structurally forces exactly one box between its hole and the fixed pi companion, even at Gamma'=Lambda=[] -- it can never produce a flat, box-free (A-input,A-output) pair. This is a genuine feature of Definition 2.3, not a bug, and it is why Proposition 3.1 (general id-rule derivability) needs a real induction rather than a one-step smoke test.

In Lean 4, when defining a height/size function over an inductive family indexed by a value (e.g. `NestedProof : Index -> Type`) where recursive premises carry a DIFFERENT index than the constructor's own conclusion, fixing the index via `variable {Γ : Index}` before the def breaks recursive calls ('expected NestedProof Γ, got NestedProof (different index)'). Fix: write the def as `∀ {Γ}, NestedProof Γ → Nat` (universal quantification inside the type), not `variable`-fixed.
